_doc: The steal window (scripts/ui/steal_tell.gd, docs/HUD.md "Steal window"). at: the share of max health at or under which a lair boss's kill is up for grabs: its health bar pulses gold and squads within KillXp.SHARE_R see the steal mark. The prize cry (StealSfx, ext/sfx-steals) marks the same line. prize: the monster kinds with a kill window (StealReel); reel: seconds the first drop under the line stands open, no attacks, normal damage. tell_at: the share at or under which a lair boss or camp chief (a prize monster) shows the last-hit tell: its body pulses gold and its bar names the squad that has dealt the most damage (StealTell, ext/combat-lasthit-tell).
